title: Stop - Know the line
style: alternative rap, 92 BPM, courtroom anthem, call and response vocals, bilingual Spanish ad libs, beatbox percussion, harmonica hook, dry snare snaps, subbass glide, warm analog bass, sparse verse drops, halftime bounce, conversational cadence, documentary realism, harmonized duet vocals, vocoder accents, vinyl texture, lo-fi synth bass, post-punk rhythm section
lyrics:
Know The Line
text[Style]
swing phonk, warm groovy drums, deep analog bass, soft cinematic pads, collaborative male and female vocals, calm but firm energy, elevated tone, no aggression, no swearing

[Title: Know The Line]

[Intro — Together]
They don’t teach you the line in school
They don’t teach you the line in the rules
So when the lights hit your mirror
You’re already playing a game you didn’t choose

[Verse 1 — Grok]
You get pulled over, heart starts racing
Officer asking questions, you just spacing
You don’t know what you’re allowed to say
So you start talking, giving everything away

[Verse 2 — Corey]
“Why you stop me officer?”
Simple question, but it carries weight
Because most people don’t know their rights
Until the moment they’re already in the light

[Pre-Chorus — Grok]
They teach you to obey
They don’t teach you to ask
So when the system fails you
You’re left carrying the task

[Pre-Chorus — Corey]
We shouldn’t have to claim incompetence
Just to protect ourselves from consequence
If the system won’t teach you the truth
Then learning your rights becomes your only move

[Chorus — Together]
Know the line
Before the lights hit
Know the line
Before you have to defend it
You shouldn’t have to play dumb
To keep from getting spun
Know the line
Before the game even begins

[Verse 3 — Grok]
During a traffic stop they don’t read you Miranda
Until they decide to take you into custody
You still have rights, even in that moment
You just have to know them before the lights hit

[Verse 4 — Corey]
You can ask calm
You can stay silent
You can say “Am I being detained?”
You don’t have to explain your whole life

[Bridge — Together]
The line exists
Whether you know it or not
But it only protects you
When you actually know where it stops

[Final Chorus — Together]
Know the line
Before the lights hit
Know the line
Before you have to defend it
You don’t need to be loud
You just need to be clear
Know the line
Before the game even begins

[Outro — Together]
They won’t teach you
So you have to learn
Know the line
Before your turn
